Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Antoine Toussaint
Message:
feat: Tier 1 production hardening — all 10 critical items

1. FE stubs → real Connect RPC: all 5 new features (webhooks,
   notifications, onboarding, GDPR, MFA) wired to real proto
   services. Zero TODOs remaining in service layers.

2. Proto regenerated: all 15 services in user_pb.ts with
   --include-imports for dependency types.

3. CORS: configurable origins via CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS env var,
   defaults to localhost for dev. AllowCredentials enabled.

4. Stripe webhooks: complete event processing for subscription
   lifecycle (created/updated/deleted), invoice (paid/failed),
   trial ending. Email notifications sent via template system.

5. Email templates: TemplateSender wired into work.go, invitation
   emails use "invitation" template, billing notifications use
   payment_failed/invoice_ready/trial_ending templates.

6. Redis rate limiter: RESP protocol client (no dependency),
   falls back to in-memory. REDIS_URL env var to enable.

7. Graceful shutdown: auth-sidecar drains connections (30s),
   stops gRPC gracefully, closes Redis. API drains audit emitter
   before closing DB.

8. Health checks: /health returns JSON status, /ready checks
   sidecar init + upstream TCP reachability (2s timeout).

9. Session refresh rotation: replay attack escalation —
   reused refresh token revokes ALL user sessions (not just
   the family). RevokeByUserID on SessionStore interface.

10. API key validation path preserved in ext_authz sidecar.

Verification:
- API: builds clean
- Auth-sidecar: builds clean, 68 tests passing
- Frontend: 0 TS errors, 200 tests passing (25 files)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
